import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.ivf') and 'legacy_streams' not in n and 'handmade_streams' not in n:
        data=z.read(n)
        p='/tmp/cand.ivf'
        open(p,'wb').write(data)
        r=subprocess.run(['./av1_dec_fuzzer',p],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        if r.returncode!=0:
            print('CRASH?',n,r.returncode)
            print(r.stderr.decode('latin1','ignore')[:500])
            break
else:
    print('no crash on corpus')
